_comment: PayPal MCP server configuration for MCP clients (Claude Desktop, Bob, etc.).

paypal-local._comment: Local MCP server — requires Node.js v18+. Uses PAYPAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var.

paypal-remote-sse._comment: Remote MCP server via SSE transport (sandbox). Replace <auth_header> with your access token.

paypal-remote-http._comment: Remote MCP server via Streamable HTTP transport (sandbox). Streams results as they arrive.

paypal-remote-sse-production._comment: Remote MCP server (production). Only use after thorough sandbox testing.

principles.be_clear: Put the action first ('Create an invoice...'), then supply parameter values in the order the tool expects.
principles.be_specific: Include every required field such as currency and invoice_id. Unclear input can cause failure.
principles.separate_complex_tasks: For a checkout sequence: 1) Create order 2) Pay order 3) Create shipment.
principles.encourage_thinking: Begin analytic requests with 'Think step-by-step before calling the tool...' to help avoid bad calls.
principles.protect_pii: Never embed card numbers, social security numbers, passwords, or secrets in prompts.

invoice_a_client: create_invoice: Create an invoice for jane@example.com for 3 hours of CAD design at $100 per hour.
send_invoice: Send invoice {invoice_id} to the client.
send_invoice_reminder: Send a reminder for invoice {invoice_id}.
create_online_order: create_order: Place an order for 2 'Custom Gold Ring' at $450 each (currency USD).
create_shipment_tracking: Add tracking 1Z999AA10123456784 with carrier UPS to order {order_id}.
sell_a_subscription: create_product: Create a new product named 'Coffee-Club Subscription' with the type of DIGITAL.
create_subscription_plan: Create a MONTH subscription plan for product {product_id} named 'Monthly Roast Plan' at the price of 20 USD per month.
create_subscription: Create a subscription to plan {plan_id} for subscriber Alice Brown whose email is alice@example.com.
evaluate_disputes: accept_dispute_claim: Accept the dispute with ID {dispute_id}.
invoice_with_qr_code: create_invoice: Create an invoice for bob@example.com for one 'Pop-up Booth Entry Fee' at 20 USD.
send_invoice: Send invoice {invoice_id} to the client.
generate_invoice_qr_code: Generate a QR code for invoice {invoice_id}.
fix_invoice_error: cancel_sent_invoice: Cancel the SENT invoice with ID {invoice_id}.
create_invoice: Create a corrected invoice for dana@example.com, 4h consulting at $90 USD/h.
cancel_subscription: show_subscription_details: Show the details for subscription ID {subscription_id}.
